title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain: Pretraining Familiarity Survives a Contamination-Free Hold-Out
note: arXiv record, v1 only, 9 Sep 2026, cs.LG, single submitter. Abstract: 13 forecasters (4 classical, 3 trained per dataset, 6 pretrained) on 7 groups from 5 domains, all observations dated after the last model release, data rebuildable without API keys. Pretrained win 5 of 7 groups, lose one to Theta, tie seasonal naive on daily exchange rates.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (abstract, second part)
note: Abstract: seasonal strength and spectral entropy do not explain where pretrained models win. Largest gain: 28% lower MASE than the best classical method on weekly Wikipedia pageviews, which TimesFM's authors name as most of its corpus. TimesFM family outranks Chronos family by -0.53 ranks on Wikipedia vs -0.09 elsewhere (1,500 vs 754 series, Mann-Whitney p < 1e-5).

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text, v1)
note: Protocol: one forecast origin, 1 Jan 2026, for all groups. Checkpoints: chronos-bolt-small and -base, chronos-2, timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch, timesfm-3.0-pytorch, moirai-2.0-R-small; the text states all were published before that date and gives no table of pretraining cutoffs. Library versions are locked; no weights revisions are given.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text, v1)
note: Horizons follow M4: 14 steps daily, 13 weekly, 48 hourly; monthly Wikipedia 8 (only 8 full months after the origin). Hourly context capped at 2,016 points for every model; groups over 500 series subsampled to 500. All models univariate, no covariates. Metrics MASE, sMAPE, weighted quantile loss, 80% coverage; ranks with Nemenyi intervals, Holm-corrected Wilcoxon.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text, v1)
note: Electricity group: 46 hourly series from Energinet's Energi Data Service (Danish settlement data, load and generation columns; one all-zero hydro column dropped). Theta ranks first (avg rank 5.04, mean MASE 1.045); best pretrained mean MASE 1.155 (Chronos-2), 1.157 (TimesFM 3); six models tie with Theta. Authors read it as no evidence of an advantage, not a shown deficit.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text, v1)
note: Table 3 gain of best pretrained over best classical (mean MASE): Wikipedia daily +25.8%, weekly +28.4%, monthly +16.9%, weather +12.5%, air quality +12.6%, electricity -10.6%, exchange rates n.s. Weekly Wikipedia: TimesFM 3 1.073, Theta 1.499. A pretrained model is top-ranked in 6 of 7 groups; the authors count 5 because the Friedman test does not reject on exchange rates.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text, v1)
note: Familiarity test: the six pretrained models ranked against each other per series; TimesFM family minus Chronos family is -0.53 ranks on Wikipedia (1,500 series) and -0.09 on the other four domains (754 series), Mann-Whitney p under 1e-5, rank-biserial -0.13. Authors call it an association from one corpus and one domain, not a mechanism, and modest in size.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain (full text, v1)
note: Limits: every pretrained model's 80% interval under-covers (electricity 0.62 to 0.69), classical methods over-cover; one origin per group, no rolling origins; two groups under 50 series; three stochastic models run with 3 seeds (spread under 8%), nine checked bit-identical. Series lists said to be fixed before results; no dated plan or registration is mentioned.

title: mahdinaser/tsfm-bench (repository)
note: Authors' repository, linked from the paper: 17 commits on master, 7 to 9 Sep 2026, head 8dedc34; MIT licence for code, no data redistributed. Folders for fetchers, harness, scripts, paper and results; lock file present. No tags or releases. The README still describes an older M4/M3/Tourism benchmark of 13 groups, not the 2026 hold-out, so it does not say how to rerun the paper.

title: tsfm-bench results directory
note: Listings of results/ and results/holdout_2026: metrics and significance folders, a data manifest, a weather manifest, timing.jsonl and determinism files for two groups (fx_daily, wiki_monthly); last changed 8 Sep 2026. Files were not opened, so per-series losses and the table numbers were not checked against them. Older M4-era metrics and smoke folders sit beside it.

title: google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch commit history (API)
note: Eleven commits: repository created 2026-08-24 22:05 UTC, weights and config uploaded 2026-08-24 22:41 UTC (6455822); later commits to 2026-09-02 (head 43046b8) are titled README, LICENSE and metadata changes. So this checkpoint appeared about eight months after the study's 1 Jan 2026 origin, against the paper's statement that every checkpoint predates it.
